svg.aria-label: Mistral Large 4 on four DGX Sparks: 35 to 40 tokens per second decode, about 600 tokens per second prefill, 65,536 tokens of context, 1.6 seconds to the first token on later turns. Pixel art of a very large cat on four small computers.
